description:
S07 E02 — General Patton's Sabre

title: Forged in Fire

title: Hitler's Secret Tunnels

title: Tuskegee Airmen: Legacy of Courage
description: Exploring the legacy of the Tuskegee Airmen, the legendary group of African American pilots, revealing how these warriors for change helped end segregation in the military and pave the way for the civil rights movement.

title: Nazis on Drugs: Hitler and the Blitzkrieg
description: An incredible, long-hidden history of a devious plan to find the chemical edge the Nazis knew they would need to conquer the world; most shocking of all, this vast drug conspiracy is straight from rare historical records secured by the Allies.
